# Carbon price history

EU carbon allowances sold for under €10 a tonne for most of the 2010s, then climbed above €80 after reforms tightened supply. Here is every year since 2012, with the UK price since its scheme began in 2021.

Source: EEX EU ETS primary auction reports, volume-weighted monthly averages.

## UK carbon price since 2021

Source: UK ETS Authority monthly average UK Allowance prices, GOV.UK, Open Government Licence v3.0.

## Carbon price history questions

What was the highest EU carbon price?

The highest EU auction clearing price since 2012 was €97.51, in 2022. The highest average for a full year was €83.25, in 2023.

What was the lowest EU carbon price?

The lowest EU auction clearing price since 2012 was €2.65, in 2013. The lowest average for a full year was €4.38, in 2013.

What was the highest UK carbon price?

The highest official monthly average UK Allowance price was £89.05, in August 2022. The lowest was £35.35, in February 2024. These are monthly averages published by the UK ETS Authority; prices on individual days went higher and lower.

Why does the UK carbon price history start in 2021?

The UK Emissions Trading Scheme began on 1 January 2021, after the UK left the EU Emissions Trading System. Auctions and trading of UK Allowances began on 19 May 2021, so the official monthly averages start in May 2021. Until the end of 2020 UK installations were part of the EU scheme, so the EU figures on this page are the relevant history for those years.

Can I download carbon price history?

Yes. The data page has free CSV files of the official monthly UK prices since May 2021 and the monthly EU auction averages since 2012. Please credit CarbonPrice.co.uk and keep the source lines inside each file.

Where do these figures come from?

EU figures are the clearing prices of EU ETS primary auctions published by EEX, averaged by volume. UK figures are the official monthly averages published by the UK ETS Authority on GOV.UK under the Open Government Licence. Neither is an intraday or futures closing price.
